technical_quality: Adequate. Adequate inspiration (approximately 8-9 posterior ribs visible), no significant rotation (spinous processes roughly midway between medial clavicular ends), adequate penetration with thoracic spine faintly visible through the cardiac shadow. Lung apices are slightly cropped at the top edge of the image; a large portion of the upper abdomen is included inferiorly. Contrast is somewhat high but the lungs are diagnostically assessable.

devices.type: External radiographic lead/side marker with clip (letters visible, e.g. 'CA'), external artifact only
devices.location: Image upper right corner, i.e. over the PATIENT's left shoulder / left axillary soft tissue, outside the lung fields

description_zh: 正位胸部X光，吸氣量足夠，無明顯旋轉，影像品質尚可，僅肺尖略被裁切。雙側肺野清晰，上、中、下肺野均無實質化、結節、腫塊或氣胸；肺門及血管紋理正常，雙側肋膈角銳利，無肋膜積液。心臟大小正常（心胸比小於0.5），縱膈及氣管位置正中，輪廓正常；骨骼及軟組織未見異常。左肩區域可見外部鉛字標記，無胸管、中心導管或其他體內裝置。整體為正常胸部X光。
